An '''iron mattock''' is the [[Iron equipment|iron]] [[mattock]], crafted from [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. It mines at speed 6 and has 500 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/iron_mattock.json}}</ref>

As a [[mattock]], it works as both a shovel and a hoe, at a lower mining speed than the iron shovel or hoe.

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both shovel and hoe blocks at speed 6.

In Matcha Flavoured, hoes also mine wool, carpets, glow lichen and [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]] quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 4 damage with an attack speed of 4.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/iron_ingot_from_blasting_iron_materials.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack speed 3 (real value 4).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/iron_mattock.json}}</ref>
